title: eriogonum pyrolifolium subsp. coryphaeum
intro: Eriogonum pyrolifolium subsp. coryphaeum, commonly known as Desert Buckwheat, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the Polygonaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a useful natural remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Desert Buckwheat include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Eriogonum pyrolifolium subsp. coryphaeum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
